answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 24516 Country: United Kingdom Title: I am divorced from my husband for 1 year. I have a daughter with him who is 4 he said to me he doesn't what to See his daughter it has been 1 half years he hasn't seen his daughter. He got married again and has kids. I am scared that I bring my daughter up and when she grows up she runs away from me goes to her father who doesn't love her. I love my daughter I cry. Every day because I am scared he will take her away from me can u please give me a dua so I can read on my daughter who doesn't goes away from me stays away from her father who doesn't love her please help me Question: I am divorced from my husband for 1 year. I have a daughter with him who is 4 he said to me he doesn't what to See his daughter it has been 1 half years he hasn't seen his daughter. He got married again and has kids. I am scared that I bring my daughter up and when she grows up she runs away from me goes to her father who doesn't love her. I love my daughter I cry. Every day because I am scared he will take her away from me can u please give me a dua so I can read on my daughter who doesn't goes away from me stays away from her father who doesn't love her please help me Answer ID: 24516 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1475/1154/B=1431) According to Shariah, the right of nourishment of daughter after the wife is divorced is on mother up to the age of nine and all the expenses will incur on father. Then the daughter can be handed over to the father. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
